reason: The module's established architecture: layering, envelope handling, searchPaginate reuse, the --x/--x-id convention, metadata cache keying, the error map, and §14's live-verified findings. This milestone's design.md deliberately does not repeat any of it.
The slice/gate pattern this task follows, plus the ground rules on forbidden core files and the wire.ts ERROR_CODE_OVERRIDES exception.

Authoritative 65-endpoint report. §2.4 covers POST /libraries/{id}/plans and the plan_types lookup; §2.1 covers POST /libraries and the suites tree. Note §10's undetermined items and the corrections S6 already applied.
Layer layout and the enforced cli->{api,core} / api->core invariant. New endpoints touch endpoints.ts + api/ + cli/commands/ in that order.
Error hierarchy and exit-code table. Needed for the date-parse UsageError (exit 2) and for judging which observed codes justify an ERROR_CODE_OVERRIDES row.
Forbidden patterns — in particular the ban on matching error message text, which rules out one of the two candidate fixes for the runWrite retry narrowing in design §8.
Search before adding a helper. TestPlanType, parseTestPlanType, listSuites and iterateSuites already exist; this milestone is mostly assembly.
Required reading when a feature spans 3+ layers. The two create leaves span endpoints -> api -> metadata -> cli.
Conventional Commits, enforced by npm run check:commits in CI. One commit per slice.
